name: Force Vanguard
description: A brawler who fights with knuckles and gauntlets, trading blows toe to toe.

abilities.name: Marked Prey
abilities.description: Your first hit marks a target (within 30 blocks, 30 s cooldown): +50% damage against it. Unmarked targets take 15% less. When the marked target dies, the mark jumps to a nearby enemy.
